description: 532 nm numerical diagnostic; source config and artifact must both be 532 nm. Provisional legacy energy tolerances, not the shape-only full-campaign decision.
corner_source: User-authorized single-axis half-field exploration up to 2 degrees; not a measured physical FOV.
notes: Use newly fitted 532 nm artifacts, never relabel 450 nm artifacts.
For the user-requested shape-only 9-window / 25-field full32 study use validate_psf_campaign.py --wavelength-nm 532; this legacy pair diagnostic still includes energy and edge criteria.
Detector pitch and propagation distance remain the historical engineering configuration, not a verified 532 nm hardware model.
The phase library is a wavelength-dependent, phase-only P400/H600 polynomial approximation; no independent full-wave or amplitude calibration claim.
Fixed aperture n=800 and dx=400 nm. FFT padding is independent and recorded explicitly.
